clauses.requirement: An assembly of two independent lamps type approved as a lamp marked "D" shall be applicable only to front and rear position lamps, stop lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, daytime running lamps and direction indicator lamps.

An interdependent lamp system type approved as lamps marked "Y" shall be applicable only to front and rear position lamps, stop lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, daytime running lamps and direction indicator lamps.

Lamps shall comply with the provisions of UN R148 para 4.5 for lamps as such or grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated (applicable to the rear lamp combining several functions in one housing).
Lamps approved as front or rear position lamps are deemed to be also approved as end-outline marker lamps.
Front and rear position lamps which are grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated may also be used as end-outline marker lamps.

Position lamps or daytime running lamps reciprocally incorporated with another function, using a common light source and designed to operate permanently with an additional system regulating the intensity of the emitted light, are permitted.

For a rear position lamp reciprocally incorporated with a stop lamp (with common light source and intensity regulation system per 4.5.3), these functions shall either (a) be provided by multiple light sources (for instance a double filament light source); or (b) be intended for use in a vehicle equipped with a tell-tale indicating failure of the lamps; in either case a note shall be made in the communication document.

If a front position lamp incorporates one or more infrared radiation generators, its photometric and colour requirements shall be met both with and without operation of the infrared radiation generator(s).
